name: Convert
headline: Full-stack experimentation and an MCP server for a platform behind 40,000+ sites
overview: Convert.com is an A/B testing and experimentation platform serving agencies and e-commerce brands. Techlio partnered with Convert to extend and scale the platform: full-stack experimentation, an improved visual editor and a remote MCP server that powers AI-driven experimentation workflows.

challenges.title: Scaling to full-stack experimentation
challenges.text: Convert needed server-side feature flags, rollouts and a headless API without disrupting existing customers.

challenges.title: AI workflow integration
challenges.text: Customers wanted to automate their experimentation cycle through AI tooling, which needed a stable MCP server.

challenges.title: Flicker-free performance
challenges.text: New capabilities had to preserve zero-flicker rendering across every feature.

challenges.title: Complex targeting at scale
challenges.text: Agencies needed 40+ audience filters and trustworthy statistics with no impact on page speed.

solutions.title: Full-stack experimentation module
solutions.text: A server-side layer with feature flags, staged rollouts and a headless API.

solutions.title: Remote MCP server
solutions.text: A stable remote MCP server that lets teams automate the experimentation cycle, from hypothesis to analysis, with AI assistants.

solutions.title: Goals and statistics engine
solutions.text: Custom conversion tracking with Frequentist and Bayesian engines, SRM checks and collision prevention.

solutions.title: Performance-first architecture
solutions.text: Every new feature engineered to keep the flicker-free standard and leave Core Web Vitals unaffected.

results: Full-stack experimentation launched across all plan tiers
MCP server integration enabling AI-automated experimentation workflows
40+ audience targeting filters live in production
Zero increase in snippet load time after the feature expansion
architecture: React and Node.js, with .NET services, run on PostgreSQL and AWS, built so the tracking snippet adds no load time. A remote MCP server exposes the platform to AI assistants, and ServiceNow supports service workflows.
